thought.title: fp16 direct compute with Exp-based SiLU and larger chunk size
thought.description: Replaced fp32 intermediate computation with fp16 direct compute. Eliminated 2 Cast operations per chunk (half->float32 and float32->half). Used Exp-based SiLU: val/(1+exp(-val)) instead of tanh-based sigmoid approximation. Increased vector chunk size from 64 to 256 for better vector unit utilization.
thought.reason: For memory-bound element-wise operators, data type conversions between fp16 and fp32 add significant overhead (2 vector ops per chunk). Computing directly in fp16 eliminates this overhead. The Exp-based sigmoid uses fewer operations than the tanh-based approximation (Muls+Exp+Adds+Div vs Muls+Tanh+Adds+Muls+Mul).
thought.target_bottleneck: fp32 cast overhead in element-wise memory-bound kernel

runtime.dsl_after:
// Optimized: fp16 direct + Exp sigmoid
Adds(gate, input[start], 0, chunk);      // copy (no cast)
Adds(val, input[half+start], 0, chunk);  // copy (no cast)
Muls(tmp, val, -1.0f, chunk);            // -val
Exp(tmp, tmp, chunk);                    // exp(-val)
Adds(tmp, tmp, 1.0f, chunk);             // 1+exp(-val)
Div(val, val, tmp, chunk);               // silu = val/(1+exp(-val))
Mins(val, val, 1.0f, chunk);             // clip
Mul(gate, gate, val, chunk);             // result
Adds(output[start], gate, 0, chunk);     // copy (no cast)
